title: JournalEntry
requirements: 04.01. `JournalEntry[T]` is declared with `@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)`.
04.02. It contains exactly the required public fields with the required names and annotations: `sequence`, `eventType`, `payload`, `metadata`, and `createdAt`.
04.03. Direct construction validates `sequence` as an exact integer.
04.04. Direct construction rejects `bool` as `sequence`.
04.05. Direct construction rejects sequence numbers less than or equal to zero.
04.06. Direct construction validates `eventType` as a string before calling string methods.
04.07. Surrounding whitespace is removed from `eventType`.
04.08. The normalized `eventType` must contain at least one non-whitespace character.
04.09. Direct construction validates that `metadata` is a mapping.
04.10. Every metadata key is validated as a string.
04.11. Every metadata value is validated as a string.
04.12. Metadata values are preserved without coercion or trimming.
04.13. Surrounding whitespace is removed from metadata keys.
04.14. A normalized metadata key must remain non-blank.
04.15. Stored metadata is an independent immutable mapping.
04.16. Mutation of the caller's original metadata mapping cannot alter stored metadata.
04.17. Direct construction validates `createdAt` as a `datetime`.
04.18. A supplied naive `createdAt` is rejected.
04.19. Timezone awareness checks both `tzinfo` and `utcoffset()`.
04.20. Validation errors produce deliberate `TypeError` or `ValueError` exceptions rather than incidental attribute errors.
